name: Resilient REIT Limited
source: CRON 20261014: H1 2026 column added from Resilient REIT Limited unaudited consolidated interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (JSE SENS filing of 12 August 2026, condensed consolidated statement of comprehensive income, page 12 of the interim results booklet), R'000 stored as absolute rand: contractual rental revenue and recoveries 2,032,197; straight-lining of rental revenue adjustment (38,666) giving total revenue 1,993,531; fair value adjustments 273,223; property operating expenses 736,093; administrative expenses 82,198; share-based payments 9,934; foreign exchange loss 69,335; impairment of investment in associate 88,476; reversal of impairment of loans to associate 40,600; impairment of loans receivable 4,015; share of profit of associates and joint venture 210,996 giving the printed profit before net finance costs 1,528,299; finance income 59,550 and finance costs 535,938 giving the printed net finance costs 476,388; profit before income tax 1,051,911; income tax 66,511; profit for the period 985,400. Mapping follows this file's existing conventions: Cost of Sales is the printed property operating expenses, Net Finance Costs is the printed gross finance costs as the FY2025 column does, and Income Tax is stored as a positive charge. Operating Expenses is stated so that gross profit less operating expenses reproduces operating profit exactly and equals administrative expenses 82,198 plus share-based payments 9,934 plus the foreign exchange loss 69,335 plus net impairments of 51,891 (88,476 impairment of associate less 40,600 reversal of loans to associate plus 4,015 impairment of loans receivable), which ties to the unit; operating profit is therefore the printed profit before net finance costs excluding fair value adjustments and the share of associates. Gate: profit before income tax 1,051,911 less income tax 66,511 equals the printed profit for the period 985,400; the Net Profit row holds the figure this file's convention uses, profit attributable to equity holders 931,093 (profit for the period 985,400 less non-controlling interests 54,307), exactly as the FY2025 column does. EPS is the printed basic earnings per share of 278.85 cents, stored in rand as 2.7885 (earnings attributable 931,093,000 divided by the 334,075,422 shares in issue for IFRS). Gross, operating and net margin are computed from this column. ROE, ROA and Debt to Equity are left empty for H1 2026 because no H1 2026 balance sheet inputs were read into those rows in this pass. | Yahoo Finance
